title: 7.18.3 Lab: Attack, guard or potion
description: Each turn is a choice: 1 attacks, 2 guards (the next hit is halved) and 3 drinks a potion. One act(t, a, roll) does all three, for you and for an enemy that chooses for itself.

steps.title: Run it
steps.instructions: This is your game from 7.17.3: press 1 to attack and the goblin hits back. 2 and 3 do nothing yet.
hints: If you brought your 7.17.3 work forward, your names may differ; keep yours. Where a step quotes a line, change the line of yours that does the same job.

steps.title: A guard flag
steps.instructions: In the constructor, below `this.color = color;`, add `this.guarding = false;`. At the top of `takeHit`, before the line that takes the hp: `if (this.guarding) n = floor(n / 2);` and then `this.guarding = false;`. Below `attack`, write `guard() { this.guarding = true; }`. In the class's `draw(x, y)`, right after the body's `circle(x, y, 70);`, draw a gold ring while guarding: `if (this.guarding) { noFill(); stroke('gold'); strokeWeight(4); circle(x, y, 86); noStroke(); }`. Run: nothing looks different yet, because nobody can guard.
hints: `noStroke()` at the end of the ring matters: without it, the name and the bars would be drawn with a gold outline too.

steps.title: Potions, and a new constructor value
steps.instructions: Change the constructor's first line to `constructor(name, maxHp, power, potions, color) {` and add `this.potions = potions;` below `this.color = color;`. **Every `new Fighter(...)` now needs the potions, in fourth place:** in `newGame()`, make the hero `new Fighter('Hero', 30, 3, 2, 'gold')` and the goblin `new Fighter('Goblin', 24, 5, 1, 'orange')` (the goblin hits harder now, power 5, because you can guard against it). Count your values in each one: name, maxHp, power, potions, color, five in all. Below `guard()`, write `heal()` from the reading. In the class's `draw`, add the potions to the numbers line: `text(this.hp + '/' + this.maxHp + '  potions ' + this.potions, x - 60, y + 98, 12, '#ccc');`. Run: `potions 2` under you and `potions 1` under the goblin.
hints: If a fighter is drawn black, its line says `potions gold` (or `potions NaN` after a potion), one `new Fighter(...)` still has the old four values.
The values are matched by place: name, maxHp, power, potions, color.

steps.title: attackTurn becomes act
steps.instructions: Change the first line of `attackTurn` to `function act(t, a, roll) {`. `a` will be the action: 1 attack, 2 guard, 3 potion. Then fix the two lines that still call `attackTurn`: in `draw()`, `attackTurn(0, floor(random(0, 4)))` becomes `act(0, 1, floor(random(0, 4)))`, and in `enemyTurn`, `attackTurn(1, floor(random(0, 4)))` becomes `act(1, 1, floor(random(0, 4)))`. Run: the game plays as before, now through `act`.
hints: The `1` in `act(0, 1, ...)` is the action: attack.
An error that says attackTurn is not defined means one call still uses the old name.

steps.title: Three actions
steps.instructions: In `act`, change the message line into three lines, one per action: `if (a === 1) message = me.name + ' hits ' + them.name + ' for ' + me.attack(them, roll);`, `if (a === 2) { me.guard(); message = me.name + ' guards'; }` and `if (a === 3) message = me.name + ' drinks a potion: +' + me.heal();`. Leave the rest of `act` as it is. Run: the game plays as before, because every call still asks for action 1. To try a guard now, in `draw()` change `act(0, 1, ...)` to `act(0, 2, ...)` and press 1: a gold ring appears, and the goblin's next hit is halved. The next step replaces that line anyway.
hints: The roll is only used by an attack; guarding and drinking ignore it.

steps.title: The keys pick the action
steps.instructions: Below `act`, write `function choose(a) { act(turn, a, floor(random(0, 4))); }`. In `draw()`, replace the line for key 1 with: `if (!over && turn === 0) { let a = 0; if (kb.presses('1')) a = 1; if (kb.presses('2')) a = 2; if (kb.presses('3')) a = 3; if (a !== 0) choose(a); }`. In `newGame()`, the first message becomes `'Your turn: 1 attack, 2 guard, 3 potion'`. Run: press 2 and a gold ring appears; the goblin's next hit is halved. Take some hits, then press 3.
hints: `a` stays 0 on a frame when no key was pressed, and then nothing happens.

steps.title: The enemy chooses
steps.instructions: In `enemyTurn`, below `if (over || turn !== 1) return;`, replace the `act(1, 1, ...)` line with the enemy's rule from the reading: `const e = fighters[1];`, `let a = 1;`, `if (e.hp < e.maxHp / 3 && e.potions > 0) a = 3;`, `else if (random() < 0.25) a = 2;` and then `act(1, a, floor(random(0, 4)));`. Run and play a few fights: sometimes the goblin guards. To see it drink, in `newGame()`, on the line below the one that makes the fighters, add `fighters[1].hp = 6;`, press 1 once, and watch its turn. Then delete the test line.
hints: 6 out of 24 is less than a third, and the goblin has one potion, so it drinks.
Try a whole fight using guard and potions, and one only attacking: which goes better?

requirements.title: Guard halves the next hit
requirements.description: While a fighter is guarding, takeHit halves the hit (rounded down) and then turns the guard off; guard() turns it on. Help: 7.18.1 (Reading: Three actions, a flag and a count)

requirements.title: A potion heals, capped, and uses one up
requirements.description: heal gives hp back but never above maxHp, takes one potion off the count, and does nothing when none are left. Help: 7.18.1 (Reading: Three actions, a flag and a count)

requirements.title: Keys 1 to 3 pick the action
requirements.description: On your turn, 1, 2 and 3 each pick an action. Help: 7.18.1 (Reading: Three actions, a flag and a count)

requirements.title: The enemy can choose too
requirements.description: The enemy picks its action by a rule: a potion when it is low, or a guard by chance, instead of always attacking. Help: 7.18.1 (Reading: Three actions, a flag and a count)
requirements.hint: if (e.hp < e.maxHp / 3 && e.potions > 0) a = 3;  else if (random() < 0.25) a = 2;

requirements.title: Every fighter gets five values
requirements.description: Each new Fighter(...) is handed five values, in this order: name, maxHp, power, potions, color. Help: 7.18.1 (Reading: Three actions, a flag and a count)

aiCheck.rubricTitle: What the AI read in your code
aiCheck.prompt: The student wrote a moSHion sketch for "Lab: Attack, guard or potion". The task: add a guarding flag that halves the next hit with floor(n / 2) in takeHit and is then cleared, a potions count (a new constructor value, so every new Fighter call is handed five values: name, maxHp, power, potions, color) and heal(), which gives up to 12 hp back capped at maxHp and uses one up, doing nothing when none are left; one act(t, a, roll) does action 1 attack, 2 guard or 3 potion; keys 1, 2 and 3 pick the action on your turn; and the enemy chooses, drinking when it is low and has a potion and guarding some of the time. Accept any names, helpers, ternaries, nested ifs, switch statements and semicolons; a line only in a comment or string does not count. Short, plain notes for a 14-year-old; never write corrected code.
